name: Bocas del Toro, Panama

rent.notes: A furnished 2BR runs $550-1,000 (October 2026). International Living cites a 2BR/2BA with A/C at $1,100, and 2025 expat reports put a 2BR at $500-900. A pet-friendly house for a large dog is scarcer, so min is set above the cheapest listings.

groceries.notes: Bocas couples report $400-500 a month on groceries with the island import markup already included. Dog food adds about $50-100 based on 2023 mainland bag prices, and island prices are likely higher. Expats report saving about 40% by stocking up at Costco in David.

utilities.notes: Bocas electricity runs $30-150 depending on A/C, and one expat couple reports about $100. Water is $6-20 and gas $2-10.

healthcare.notes: Private health insurance premiums for two adults age 60-61. Min is two Family Medical Plan memberships ($117.30 each, ages 60-69); typical and max reflect 2026 local quotes of $6,000-10,000/yr for a couple age 60. Premiums are national and age-rated. Pensionado discounts apply to services, not premiums.

insurance.notes: Placeholder for renters/contents insurance; no published premiums in Panama.

petDaycare.notes: No daycare was found, so this is modeled as boarding at the national rate of $10-30 a night, 2-4 nights a month. Island boarding for a 100 lb dog may not be available.

sources.title: Pets in Panama - Relofirm

petGrooming.notes: National rate of $20-40 per groom, modeled as about one a month. Whether a groomer exists on Isla Colon was not confirmed.

sources.title: Pets in Panama - Relofirm

transportation.notes: No car. Water taxis are $3 between islands and $6 to the mainland, about $50-90 a month for comfortable use, plus a bike or walking. Occasional Air Panama flights to Panama City run $80-150 one way, and KAYAK shows typical fares of $184-523.

entertainment.notes: Internet options: fiber at $35-55 (25-100 Mbps), Starlink at about $75, or PaNETma Professional at $99 in Bocas Town. Also included: streaming at $7-50 and about four dinners for two a month at $120-250.
